name: hstack
description: Skill files that let your AI coding agent set up self-hosted Hermes for you: deploy, wire 71 integrations, connect 8 messaging platforms, and keep it healthy.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and operate a self-hosted Hermes agent from your coding agent
interface.longDescription: hstack gives your AI coding agent 94 recipes for standing up a self-hosted Hermes agent on your own server: one-command deploy, 71 hardened service integrations, 8 messaging platforms, scheduled tasks, backups, and failure diagnosis. Every skill is SSH-first, verifies credentials against the live vendor API before writing anything, and rolls back cleanly on failure.
defaultPrompt: Deploy Hermes to my server and wire up Telegram.
Integrate Notion, HubSpot, and Salesforce into my Hermes agent.
Something's wrong with my Hermes gateway.
